verdicts.reason: A keeps a real RSVP Free button, but it drops the Solstice logo. It also packs five narrow columns into 320x50: the subhead is squeezed into an unreadable ragged column, the time text and the tiny URL line can't be read, and the chips are stacked vertically and cramped against the button. B keeps the logo and reads cleanly left to right with the headline and date. However, its CTA has shrunk to a barely visible line of orange text with no button, so the main action is buried. Its chip row and three lines of body copy are also too small to read at this size.
